en: A black-and-white portrait photograph of a seated man in a suit, with his body turned slightly to the side and his gaze directed towards the camera. The style is formal, typical of early 20th-century studio portraits. The upper left corner is inscribed with the name 'John Forsell' in elegant cursive script, and in the bottom left corner is the text 'Phot Herm. Hamnqvist.' The bottom right has the code 'P. H. 1742.' There are no other visible landmarks, only the person and the backdrop.
